mapper.insert: insert into product (name, description, sku, category_id, status, price, is_del, create_time, update_time) values (#{name}, #{description}, #{sku}, #{categoryId}, #{status}, #{price}, #{isDel}, now(), now())
mapper.update: update product set name = #{name}, description = #{description}, sku = #{sku}, category_id = #{categoryId}, status = #{status}, price = #{price}, create_time = #{createTime}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and is_del = 0
update product set is_del = 1, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and is_del = 0
mapper.select: select id, name, description, sku, category_id, status, price, is_del, create_time, update_time from product where id = #{id} and is_del = 0
